data_fields.name: hack_ban_minutes
data_fields.donor_constant: ban_hack_trade in minutes, default 0; ban call passes ban_hack_trade*60

best_idea: a trade is two locks and one commit: each side locks its own offer, the server settles only when both locks are current, and any change releases both locks so nothing can be swapped after a confirm
decision_why: keep the two-step OK then Trade confirm, range gate, commit-time re-check and fail-closed rule; make OK a joint freeze (any edit clears both OKs) and settle all rows in one all-or-nothing transaction, because the donor lets the partner change the offer after the other side pressed OK and moves items one slot at a time
acceptance: A offers 5 potions, B presses OK, A edits to 1 potion: both OK flags clear and B's Trade press does not commit; B one potion short at commit: whole trade refused, both inventories and zeny unchanged
